headline: More room at the top of the panel.
notes: Settings › Hover tips now turns off Premiere's own grey tooltips too, not just the help line at the foot of the panel. Turn it back on and they return
Remove Trace+ markers in the marker colour bar is now a crossed-out marker icon instead of the words. Point at it to read what it does

Cut one of the subclips from Build a sequence of N spans into your edit and that part of the clip no longer reads as never used. The coverage bar, the never-used spans and the gap totals now count uses of the clip's subclips and other imports of the same file, but never their uses inside a stringout

With Settings › Put used clips back automatically on, a span subclip you cut into your edit moves out of _STRINGOUTS and back into the bin its master clip is in. One undo step, its colour untouched, and the clip's _STRINGOUT bin stays where it is. If the master is in more than one bin, or nowhere outside _STRINGOUTS, it is left alone and the scan report says why

Each project now remembers its own ticks and view for the session. Switch to another project and back, or close one and open it again, and its Project or Active cut view, tab, sort, hidden rows and ticked rows come back as you left them – a project you open for the first time starts clean, and a ticked row that has since left the project is dropped

On a narrow panel, a retimed clip in the Active cut shows a small amber gauge in its own column instead of a squashed tag, so every row's type icon and use count line up. Point at the gauge for the speed
Every section heading in the Project view has its tick box, Used media and Not used media included, so a folded list can still be ticked in one press

Hidden rows are now a small chip at the end of the filter row – an eye with a line through it and the count – instead of a bar across the panel. Press it to see the hidden rows in place, dimmed and in italic, each with its own eye to bring it back one at a time, even with the eye column off. Unhide all sits beside the chip while they are showing
Offline clips ticked in the Used list can now be moved into _OFFLINE too – before, Move only appeared for clips nothing uses. Used clips still never go into _UNUSED
Clips in a bin's list show the Source icon on hover too, like every other view
The never used spans in a clip's view show the Source icon on hover too – press it to open the clip in the Source Monitor with in and out set to that span
More space above the toolbar at the top of the panel
Filters sits closer to the ☰ menu
Every row in the Project, clip and sequence views now ends with a small Source icon that appears when you point at it – nothing on the row moves to make room
Sort the Active cut and Project lists by name, type or number of uses: click a heading, click it again to reverse
The Search box is no longer pinned to the panel by default; pin it again with the pin beside Search in the Filters menu
Timeline is now an icon switch just left of Filters, lit purple while it is on, instead of a third button beside Active cut and Project

Pins in the Filters menu say what they are: an unpinned filter shows a yellow struck-out pin that turns purple when you point at it, and a pinned one shows a grey pin that turns into a yellow struck-out pin – the colour on hover is what the press will do

Re-scan pressed while the Project view is still reading the project now waits for that scan to finish – before, it could briefly list every file as not used and offer to move clips that are in the cut
Switching to another project, or closing it, now clears the panel – the last project's lists, ticks and hidden rows no longer stay on screen, and closing shows No project open
Clips moved into _OFFLINE, _DUPLICATE IMPORTS or a bin you named keep their colour label – only _UNUSED colours them tan
Pressing Markers twice quickly no longer adds every marker twice
Showing hidden rows in one view no longer shows them in the other
Ticked boxes now show a tick, and a half-ticked sequence box a short bar
With Offline lit in the Project view, Not placed and Used only in archived sequences list only offline files too
The bin path under each Project row now starts under the name, and the toolbar no longer jumps 2px when you switch views
The first scan of a big project no longer runs twice, and going back to the Project view no longer re-measures every file on disk

Names no longer vanish in a narrow dock: a Project row's count now says just the uses – 2 uses – and the number of sequences moves to the bin line under the name and to the help when you point at the count. Names always keep some room, and on a narrow dock the type tag becomes the small Video, Audio or Stills icon
In a narrow dock the Active cut list counts uses without the length, so the clip names have room

One way to select all, everywhere: a tick box in each list's heading, in line with the rows' boxes, ticks everything the list shows – a bar in it means some are ticked, a tick means all. It replaces ✓ All in the Project view, Select all on each sequence heading in a clip's list, and Select all in the bar at the foot, which stays only in a bin's list. Cmd-click (Ctrl-click on Windows) a sequence heading's box to add its uses to what is already ticked

A clip's view says each number once: the line under the name has gone (the used pane now carries the sections and the total length), sequence headings no longer repeat the use count, and All cuts, Active only and Hide old no longer carry numbers – they counted cuts while the buttons above them count uses
A clip that is not used anywhere now shows its never-used span, with its Source icon, under one plain sentence – instead of zeros in six places, three dead buttons and a dead pager
The arrows at the foot of the panel are hidden whenever there is nothing to step through, instead of sitting greyed round a dash
Used 2+ looks the same in the Active cut view as in the Project view – the same chip and the same icon – and on a narrow dock Used 2+ and Retimed keep just their icon and count
The Type and Uses columns keep the same widths in every list, so they no longer jump sideways when you switch views or tabs
The Not used list no longer has an empty Uses column – the names get the room

Duplicate imports rows say it in one grey line – 1 spare · can go – instead of a SPARE tag, an items tag and a cut-off note, and the list has the same column headings as the others: tick box, Name, Type and Spare
Every filter chip counts the same way: the word, then the number in grey – Retimed 2, Used 2+ 49 – with no brackets
The status line at the foot no longer shows the scan timing and the click hints all the time – it speaks when something happens. How long a scan took is still in the scan report
Sequence names in a clip's list keep their real case – Brand Film v04, not BRAND FILM V04
Docked as a short bar under the timeline, the Project view folds its summary away by itself so the list always has room, and brings it back when the panel is tall enough again
Settings › Summary + bars is now remembered between sessions. Hiding it takes the Project view back to its media list, so you are never left on a list whose button is hidden
The column sort is now remembered between sessions, for each list
Reset to defaults, at the foot of Settings, puts every preference back as it was on first install – your licence, the tours and the bins Trace+ has filed into are kept
The Markers tab in Settings is now called Colours – it holds the label picker as well as the marker colour
The note at the foot of Settings › Organisation is one line now – Nothing here deletes anything · Builds add 1–2 undo steps the first time – and the help strip no longer repeats it
New installs start with only Media and Used 2+ pinned above the list; the other filters are one press away in Filters. If you have already pinned or unpinned filters, your choice is kept
Docked very short, the toolbar at the top is slimmer, as it was always meant to be, so the list keeps more of the height
